Question: What percentage of delivered orders arrived later than the estimated delivery date?
text:
```sql
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date 
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
                     END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_delivery_percentage
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered';
```
This query calculates the percentage of orders marked as delivered whose actual delivery date was later than the estimated delivery date.
